meaning.en: Desolate, with no sign of human habitation.
meaning.zh: 荒凉偏僻，没有人家。

examples.zh: 这里荒无人烟，连手机信号都没有。
examples.en: It's uninhabited here; there's not even a phone signal.

examples.zh: 他们穿过荒无人烟的戈壁滩。
examples.en: They crossed the deserted Gobi.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: Without exception; no one or nothing can be left out.
meaning.zh: 一概不能例外，没有谁或什么可以除外。

examples.zh: 在法律面前人人平等，任何人概莫能外。
examples.en: Everyone is equal before the law; no one is exempt.

examples.zh: 经济下行时，各行各业概莫能外。
examples.en: In an economic downturn, no industry is spared.

usage.en: Predicate; formal writing, often at the end of a clause.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多用于书面，常放句末。

meaning.en: To want to help but be unable to.
meaning.zh: 心里想帮忙，但力量不够，无法帮助。

examples.zh: 这件事超出我的权限，我爱莫能助。
examples.en: This is beyond my authority, so I'm afraid I can't help.

examples.zh: 看到他陷入困境，我却爱莫能助。
examples.en: I watched him in trouble and could do nothing to help.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用作委婉的拒绝。

meaning.en: To be deeply concerned about the nation and its people.
meaning.zh: 为国家的前途和人民的命运担忧。

equivalents: be concerned for the nation and its people

examples.zh: 杜甫一生忧国忧民，写下许多诗篇。
examples.en: Du Fu worried about the nation and its people all his life, and wrote many poems.

examples.zh: 他是一位忧国忧民的学者。
examples.en: He is a scholar who cares deeply for his country and its people.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: A thoroughly baffling or outrageous affair.
meaning.zh: 使人惊诧、不可理解的怪事。

examples.zh: 明明是他的错，反倒怪别人，真是咄咄怪事。
examples.en: It's clearly his fault, yet he blames others: truly bizarre.

examples.zh: 这么大的工程竟没人负责，咄咄怪事！
examples.en: Such a huge project and nobody in charge: how very strange!

usage.zh: 多作宾语或感叹，常带讽刺。

natural: carry a bowl of water level

meaning.en: To treat everyone fairly without favouritism.
meaning.zh: 像端一碗水不洒一样，比喻处事公平，不偏心。

examples.zh: 当领导要一碗水端平，不能偏心。
examples.en: A leader must be even-handed and not play favourites.

examples.zh: 妈妈对两个孩子一碗水端平。
examples.en: Mum treats both children equally.

usage.en: Predicate; colloquial, often 要把一碗水端平.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，口语，常说“要把一碗水端平”。

meaning.en: Brilliant and eye-catching.
meaning.zh: 光彩鲜明耀眼，非常吸引人。

examples.zh: 夜空中的烟花璀璨夺目。
examples.en: The fireworks in the night sky were dazzling.

examples.zh: 她是娱乐圈一颗璀璨夺目的明星。
examples.en: She is a dazzling star of the entertainment world.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，书面语。

meaning.en: A violent storm; also a fierce, rapid revolutionary change.
meaning.zh: 来势急猛的大风雨，也比喻声势浩大的变革或斗争。

examples.zh: 暴风骤雨过后，天空放晴。
examples.en: After the violent storm the sky cleared.

examples.zh: 这场变革如暴风骤雨，席卷整个行业。
examples.en: The change swept through the industry like a tempest.

usage.en: Predicate, subject or object; literal and figurative.
usage.zh: 可作主语、谓语、宾语，有本义与比喻义。

natural: when all is said and done

meaning.en: After all the talk; in the end.
meaning.zh: 反复地说，归根到底。

equivalents: when all is said and done
at the end of the day

examples.zh: 说来说去，还是钱的问题。
examples.en: When all is said and done, it comes down to money.

examples.zh: 我们说来说去也没个结果。
examples.en: We kept going back and forth with no result.

usage.zh: 多放句首或作谓语，口语。

meaning.en: To be extremely grateful.
meaning.zh: 非常感谢，感激的心情没有止境。

examples.zh: 你肯帮忙，我感激不尽。
examples.en: I can't thank you enough for helping.

examples.zh: 他对恩师感激不尽。
examples.en: He is deeply grateful to his teacher.

usage.en: Predicate; polite formula in speech and letters.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用作客套话。

natural: blood in the rain and gore in the wind

meaning.en: A scene of bloody slaughter and fierce struggle.
meaning.zh: 血像雨一样洒落，风里带着腥味，形容残酷的屠杀和斗争。

equivalents: a storm of blood and violence

examples.zh: 那段历史充满了血雨腥风。
examples.en: That period of history was full of bloodshed.

examples.zh: 他经历过战争年代的血雨腥风。
examples.en: He lived through the bloody years of war.

usage.zh: 多作宾语、定语，书面色彩。

natural: the one who first made burial figures

meaning.en: The originator of a bad practice.
meaning.zh: 最先做出某种恶劣事例的人。

equivalents: the originator of a bad trend

examples.zh: 这种歪风的始作俑者是谁？
examples.en: Who started this bad habit?

examples.zh: 他是这场骗局的始作俑者。
examples.en: He is the originator of this scam.

story.en: Mencius: 'The one who first made burial figures — would he not have no descendants?' (始作俑者，其无后乎).
story.zh: 《孟子·梁惠王上》：“仲尼曰：‘始作俑者，其无后乎！’”

usage.zh: 作名词，几乎总含贬义。

pinyin: zuì wēng zhī yì bù zài jiǔ
literal: drunken · old-man · 's · intent · not · in · wine
natural: the drunkard's heart is not in the wine

meaning.en: The real aim lies elsewhere than the stated one.
meaning.zh: 本意不在喝酒，而在别的方面，比喻别有用心。

examples.zh: 他天天来店里，醉翁之意不在酒，是想见老板娘。
examples.en: He comes to the shop every day, but it's not the goods he's after: he wants to see the owner.

examples.zh: 这次考察醉翁之意不在酒，而是为了谈合作。
examples.en: This inspection trip is a pretext; the real aim is to discuss cooperation.

story.en: Ouyang Xiu in 'Pavilion of the Drunken Old Man': 'The drunkard's heart is not in the wine but in the mountains and waters' (醉翁之意不在酒，在乎山水之间也).
story.zh: 欧阳修《醉翁亭记》：“醉翁之意不在酒，在乎山水之间也。”

usage.en: Standalone clause; often continued with 在乎山水之间也.
usage.zh: 多作独立分句，常接“在乎山水之间也”。

meaning.en: Completely devoid of conscience.
meaning.zh: 完全丧失良心，形容极其残忍恶毒。

examples.zh: 骗老人养老钱的人，简直丧尽天良。
examples.en: Anyone who cheats old people of their pensions has no conscience at all.

examples.zh: 这种丧尽天良的行为，必须严惩。
examples.en: Such heartless conduct must be severely punished.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，谴责意味强烈。

meaning.en: The four methods of diagnosis in traditional Chinese medicine: looking, listening/smelling, questioning and pulse-taking.
meaning.zh: 中医诊病的四种方法：看、听嗅、问、切脉。

equivalents: look, listen, ask and feel the pulse

examples.zh: 中医讲究望闻问切。
examples.en: Chinese medicine stresses looking, listening, questioning and pulse-taking.

examples.zh: 老中医通过望闻问切，很快找出了病因。
examples.en: Through the four examinations the old doctor soon found the cause.

usage.zh: 名词性短语，专业术语。

meaning.en: Needless to say; self-evident.
meaning.zh: 本来就不用多说，很明显。

examples.zh: 健康的重要性自不待言。
examples.en: The importance of health goes without saying.

examples.zh: 他的才华自不待言，人品也很好。
examples.en: His talent goes without saying; his character is fine too.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语。

natural: worship and fawn on the foreign

meaning.en: To blindly admire foreign things and fawn on foreigners.
meaning.zh: 盲目崇拜外国的东西，向外国人谄媚。

examples.zh: 买东西不能崇洋媚外，国货也有好产品。
examples.en: Don't be slavishly pro-foreign when shopping; domestic goods can be good.

examples.zh: 他留学回来后非常反感崇洋媚外的风气。
examples.en: After studying abroad he disliked the fashion of foreign worship.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: To climb the ranks and amass wealth; the classic corrupt-career ambition.
meaning.zh: 官职上升，财富增加，常指以做官谋利为目的。

equivalents: climb the greasy pole and line one's pockets

examples.zh: 他当公务员，不是为了升官发财。
examples.en: He didn't become a civil servant to get promoted and grow rich.

examples.zh: 升官发财是他唯一的梦想。
examples.en: Rising in office and getting rich is his only dream.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，有时用于调侃。

meaning.en: Without any reason or cause.
meaning.zh: 没有任何原因。

examples.zh: 他平白无故地发了一顿脾气。
examples.en: He lost his temper for no reason at all.

examples.zh: 天下没有平白无故的好事。
examples.en: There is no such thing as a free lunch.

usage.zh: 多作状语、定语。

meaning.en: To feel restless and unable to settle.
meaning.zh: 心里不安定，坐立不安。

examples.zh: 明天就要考试了，他心神不宁。
examples.en: The exam is tomorrow and he can't settle.

examples.zh: 她一整天都心神不宁，总觉得要出事。
examples.en: She was uneasy all day, feeling something would go wrong.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语。

meaning.en: Neither hot nor cold; also, lukewarm in attitude.
meaning.zh: 温度适中；也指态度不热情不冷淡。

examples.zh: 这个季节不冷不热，最适合出游。
examples.en: This season is neither hot nor cold, ideal for trips.

examples.zh: 他对我的态度不冷不热。
examples.en: His attitude to me was lukewarm.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; literal for weather, figurative for attitude.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，可指天气或态度。

meaning.en: To do something difficult reluctantly or beyond one's ability.
meaning.zh: 勉强去做自己不乐意或力量不够的事。

examples.zh: 既然大家推荐，我就勉为其难了。
examples.en: Since you all recommend me, I'll reluctantly take it on.

examples.zh: 他勉为其难地答应了。
examples.en: He agreed against his better judgement.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; also a polite-modest formula.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，也可作谦辞。

meaning.en: To travel without stopping day and night.
meaning.zh: 白天黑夜都在赶路，形容加紧赶路。

examples.zh: 救援队日夜兼程赶往灾区。
examples.en: The rescue team raced to the disaster area day and night.

examples.zh: 他日夜兼程，终于赶上了航班。
examples.en: Travelling day and night, he finally caught the flight.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。

meaning.en: To manoeuvre skilfully in diplomacy or negotiation, opening and closing alliances.
meaning.zh: 在政治、外交或谈判中运用策略，手腕灵活，进退自如。

examples.zh: 他在谈判桌上纵横捭阖，游刃有余。
examples.en: He manoeuvred with ease at the negotiating table.

examples.zh: 这位企业家纵横捭阖，几年间建起商业帝国。
examples.en: The entrepreneur wheeled and dealed his way to an empire in a few years.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语。
